history.event: Wang Tianlong built the chicken coop with his own hands
The family savings are kept in the bedroom chest
Wang Tianlong gave a dog pup to Old Chen from this house's litter

_authorshipNote: Wang Tianlong is Wang Lin's father — a mortal farmer. His residence is practical, well-maintained, with farming tools and a chicken coop. He is proud of his son but worries. The savings chest in the bedroom is the family's security. He is the one who gave Old Chen a new dog pup after the old one died — this ties the two residences together socially.
